title: Autonomy Register — Section E: Authority Limits
description: Section E of the Autonomy Register entry, as specified in STD-EDS-007.

mam_limit_per_decision.description: [Mandatory if financial authority] Must not exceed the tier-maximum for the delegation_tier per POL-EDS-002 Section 4. Zero for non-financial systems. (Source of truth: CAIO — approved per delegation tier)

mam_approval_authority.description: [Mandatory if financial authority] Values: CAIO_only │ CAIO_CRO │ BRC_approval. Must match delegation_tier requirements. (Source of truth: CAIO office)

domain_limit_daily.description: [Mandatory if financial authority] Must be ≥ mam_limit_per_decision and ≤ Board-approved domain maximum. (Source of truth: CAIO — CRO countersignature for Monitored/Delegated)

domain_limit_weekly.description: [Mandatory if financial authority] ≥ domain_limit_daily. (Source of truth: CAIO)

domain_limit_monthly.description: [Mandatory if financial authority] ≥ domain_limit_weekly. (Source of truth: CAIO)

customer_population_cap.description: [Mandatory if customer-facing] Percentage of active customer base (0.0–1.0) or absolute customer count. Zero for non-customer-facing systems. (Source of truth: CAIO — per POL-EDS-002 §5)

decision_velocity_cap.description: [Mandatory if velocity capped] Decisions per hour. Zero if no velocity cap applies. (Source of truth: CAIO — per Autonomy Budget velocity component)

domain_limit_utilisation.description: Value between 0.0 and 1.0 representing proportion of daily domain limit consumed as at review date. Triggers compliance flag at ≥ 0.80. Updated quarterly. (Source of truth: System owner — CAIO validated)
